readme: publicRules: show on EVERY public KZN school page. privateRules: show on every private school page. schools: per-school admissions, keyed by id in schools.json. Per-school 'rules' only hold things specific to that school; the province-wide ones are in publicRules so they are not repeated.

applicationWindow.text: KZN public school applications for 2027 ran from 8 April to 31 August 2026. Some schools close earlier, so check the school's own date. Apply to at least three schools.

howFarCanYouLive.short: KZN has no fixed distance. Most public schools give first choice to children whose home is closer to this school than to any other public school of the same level.
details: The KZN Department of Education does not draw feeder zones on a map. Each school's governing body writes its own admission policy, and the Head of Department can approve or change it (BELA Act, 2024).
A common KZN rule is 'nearest public school, measured from your home's gate to the school's gate'.
Some high schools also name feeder primary schools whose Grade 7s get preference.
Living close is a strong reason to be accepted, but it is not a guarantee. You can still apply to a school further away.

documents: Child's birth certificate (or proof you have applied for one)
Proof of address in the parent's name, usually a municipal, electricity or water bill or a bank statement, not older than 3 months
Latest school report and transfer card, if the child is moving from another school
ageRules: Grade R: your child must turn 5 by 30 June of the year they start.
Grade 1: your child should turn 6 by 30 June of the year they start (school is compulsory from the year they turn 7).
yourRights: A public school may not refuse your child because you can't pay the fees. You can apply for a full or partial fee exemption.
Public schools may not set entrance tests.
A child without documents must still be admitted, and the school must help you get them.
If a school refuses your child, it must give you the reasons in writing. Being put on a waiting list counts as being refused.
ifRefused: You can appeal to the MEC for Education (the provincial education minister) through the KZN Department of Education. The refusal letter should tell you how.
Go to your district or circuit education office straight away to ask for a place at another school.
publicRules.warning: Giving a false address can get your child's place cancelled and is now an offence under the BELA Act.
publicRules.comingChanges: Draft national rules (August 2025) propose a single online admissions system and this order of priority: feeder zone, siblings, staff children, then distance. Public comment closed 5 October 2025. We could not confirm they are final, so the app should not treat them as current rules.

privateRules.short: Private school: it sets its own rules. Where you live does not decide whether you get in.
usualSteps: Fill in the school's application form (often online) and pay a non-refundable application or registration fee.
Your child may be invited to an assessment or interview.
If accepted, you pay an enrolment or acceptance fee to secure the place.
Many private schools take applications all year, but popular ones fill up early, sometimes a year or more ahead.

feederZoneKinds.nearestSchool: Public KZN school. First choice goes to children for whom it is the nearest public school of that level. No km radius.
feederZoneKinds.namedSchools: Also gives preference to Grade 7s from the listed feeder primaries (see feederSchools).
feederZoneKinds.radius: School publishes a fixed km radius (radiusKm). None in Waterfall so far.
feederZoneKinds.private: Private school, own rules, address doesn't matter.
feederZoneKinds.unknown: We don't know the school's type or rules yet.

feederZone.description: Government (KZN) rules apply. The school names Hillcrest Primary, Forest View Primary and Winston Park Primary as its feeder primaries. Its written admission policy is not online.

rules: Grade 8 applications for 2027 opened 12 January 2026 and closed 15 May 2026. Grades 9 to 11 opened in June 2026.
A parent must hand-deliver the application to the front office with the form, signed code of conduct, financial clearance form and all documents. Incomplete applications are not accepted.

rules: Earlier applications get priority, so apply early. Applications roll over, so there is no need to reapply.
